NBA DFS Rankings for Thursday, October 29 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Thursday, October 29 · 3 games · First game 8:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 29, 11:31 AM ET

Jalen Johnson (ATL) ranks first on the Thursday, October 29 DraftKings main slate at 49.9 projected DraftKings points for $9,500. Domantas Sabonis (SAC, 48.8) and Deni Avdija (POR, 42.8) are next.

The table ranks all 46 players in the run by SPAGS projection, with DraftKings salary and projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 29, 11:31 AM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.
